Verses.VerseAr: الۤرٰ‌ كِتٰبٌ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ اِلَيۡكَ لِـتُخۡرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَى النُّوۡرِ  ۙ بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ اِلٰى صِرَاطِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَمِيۡدِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Alif, Lam, Ra. (Only Allah and the Messenger know the real meanings.) It is a (glorious) Book which We have revealed to you so that you may bring mankind out of the darkness (of disbelief) to the light (of faith. And moreover) by the Command of their Lord (lead them) to the path of the Almighty, the Praiseworthy —

Words.MeaningEn: so that you may bring out

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ لَهٗ مَا فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَوَيۡلٌ لِّـلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ شَدِيۡدِ ۨ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah, to Whom belongs (all) that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. And there is destruction for the disbelievers on account of severe punishment.

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡتَحِبُّوۡنَ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا عَلَى الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًا‌ؕ اُولٰۤٮِٕكَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍۢ بَعِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They are the people who love the life of this world more than the Hereafter, and hinder (the people) from the path of Allah, and look for crookedness in it (the True Din [Religion]). They (have fallen) deep into error.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوۡمِهٖ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمۡ‌ؕ فَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِىۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ‌ؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not sent any Messenger but with the language of his people so that he may make (the message of the Truth) more and more clear to them. Then Allah leads astray whom He wills and provides with guidance whom He wills. And He is Almighty, Most Wise.

Words.MeaningEn: so that he might make clear

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اَنۡ اَخۡرِجۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَى النُّوۡرِ  ۙ وَذَكِّرۡهُمۡ بِاَيّٰٮمِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيٰتٍ لّـِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوۡرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We sent Musa (Moses) with Our Signs: ‘(O Musa [Moses]), bring your people out of darkness to the light and remind them of the Days of Allah (which had come upon them and their preceding generations).’ Surely there are Signs in it for those who are highly steadfast (and) deeply grateful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰى لِـقَوۡمِهِ اذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَةَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اِذۡ اَنۡجٰٮكُمۡ مِّنۡ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُوۡمُوۡنَـكُمۡ سُوۡۤءَ الۡعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُوۡنَ اَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُوۡنَ نِسَآءَكُمۡ‌ؕ وَفِىۡ ذٰلِكُمۡ بَلَآءٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (call to mind the time) when Musa (Moses) said to his people: ‘Recall (that) blessing of Allah conferred upon you when He delivered you from the people of Pharaoh who used to afflict you with severe torment, slaying your male children and sparing the female ones. And in it was a great trial for you from your Lord.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ تَاَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَٮِٕنۡ شَكَرۡتُمۡ لَاَزِيۡدَنَّـكُمۡ‌ وَلَٮِٕنۡ كَفَرۡتُمۡ اِنَّ عَذَابِىۡ لَشَدِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (recall) when your Lord proclaimed: ‘If you thank, I shall certainly increase (My blessings on) you, and if you are ungrateful, then My torment is surely severe.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰٓى اِنۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡۤا اَنۡـتُمۡ وَمَنۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا ۙ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَـغَنِىٌّ حَمِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Musa (Moses) said: ‘If you and all others on earth disbelieve, then Allah is indeed Self-Sufficient, Most Praisworthy.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ نَبَـؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ قَوۡمِ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَ‌ۛ  ؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ‌ۛ ؕ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ‌ؕ جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَرَدُّوۡۤا اَيۡدِيَهُمۡ فِىۡۤ اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ وَقَالُوۡۤا اِنَّا كَفَرۡنَا بِمَاۤ اُرۡسِلۡـتُمۡ بِهٖ وَاِنَّا لَفِىۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَـنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِ مُرِيۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Has the account not reached you of those who have passed away before you? They were the people of Nuh (Noah) and (of the communities) of ‘Ad and Thamud and (others) who came after them. No one knows them except Allah (because they have been totally annihilated from the surface of the earth). Their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs. So they put their hands into their mouths (out of mockery and spite) and (dared) say: ‘We deny this (Din [Religion]) which you have been sent with, and we are certainly in awe-inspiring doubt about what you invite us to.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ اَفِىۡ اللّٰهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ يَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ لِيَـغۡفِرَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمۡ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ؕ قَالُوۡۤا اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَاؕ تُرِيۡدُوۡنَ اَنۡ تَصُدُّوۡنَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا فَاۡتُوۡنَا بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Their Messengers said: ‘Do you have doubt about Allah Who is the Creator of the heavens and the earth, (Who) calls you so that He forgives your sins for you and (despite your disobedience) gives you respite for a fixed term?’ They (the disbelievers) said: ‘You are but human beings like us. You seek to hold us back from these (idols) our fathers used to worship. So bring us some clear proof.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ لَهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ اِنۡ نَّحۡنُ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ وَلٰـكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَمُنُّ عَلٰى مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ‌ؕ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَاۤ اَنۡ نَّاۡتِيَكُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Their Messengers said to them: ‘Though (in constitution of self) we are humans like you, but (also mark the difference that) Allah favours whom He likes of His servants. (Then how are you equal?) And (as for clear proof) it is not for us to bring you a proof without Allah’s decree, and the believers must put their trust in Allah alone.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا لَـنَاۤ اَلَّا نَـتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ وَقَدۡ هَدٰٮنَا سُبُلَنَا‌ؕ وَلَــنَصۡبِرَنَّ عَلٰى مَاۤ اٰذَيۡتُمُوۡنَا‌ؕ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُتَوَكِّلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And what is the matter with us that we should not put our trust in Allah while He alone has shown us the paths (of guidance and success)? And we will certainly bear your persecutions with patience, and those who trust should put their trust in Allah alone.’

Words.MeaningEn: And surely we will bear with patience

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِرُسُلِهِمۡ لَـنُخۡرِجَنَّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِنَاۤ اَوۡ لَـتَعُوۡدُنَّ فِىۡ مِلَّتِنَا‌ؕ فَاَوۡحٰىۤ اِلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ لَــنُهۡلِكَنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the disbelievers said to their Messengers: ‘We will banish you by all means from our country, or you will have to return to our faith.’ Their Lord then revealed to them: ‘We shall certainly destroy the unjust people,

Words.MeaningEn: Surely we will drive you out

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـنُسۡكِنَنَّكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامِىۡ وَخَافَ وَعِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We shall certainly settle you in the (same) land after them. This (covenant) is for every such person that fears standing before My Presence and dreads My promise (of torment).’

Words.MeaningEn: And surely We will make you dwell

Verses.VerseAr: وَاسۡتَفۡتَحُوۡا وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيۡدٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (ultimately) the Messengers sought victory (from Allah), and every obstinate rebel met defeat and came to nothing.

Verses.VerseAr: مِّنۡ وَّرَآٮِٕهٖ جَهَـنَّمُ وَيُسۡقٰى مِنۡ مَّآءٍ صَدِيۡدٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Beyond this (devastation) is Hell (again). And he will be served with fetid water of oozing pus,

Words.MeaningEn: and he will be made to drink

Verses.VerseAr: يَتَجَرَّعُهٗ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيۡـغُهٗ وَيَاۡتِيۡهِ الۡمَوۡتُ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَّمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍؕ‌ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآٮِٕهٖ عَذَابٌ غَلِيۡظٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Which he will take sip by sip with great difficulty, and will not be able to gulp it down the throat. And death will assail him from all sides, and he will not be able (even) to die. And that (again) will be followed by (one more) extremely grievous torment.

Verses.VerseAr: مَثَلُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ‌ اَعۡمَالُهُمۡ كَرَمَادِۨ اشۡتَدَّتۡ بِهِ الرِّيۡحُ فِىۡ يَوۡمٍ عَاصِفٍ‌ؕ لَا يَقۡدِرُوۡنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوۡا عَلٰى شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلٰلُ الۡبَعِيۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The example of those who have rejected faith in their Lord is that their works are like ashes on which blows the strong wind on a stormy day — they are unable to grasp anything of the (works) that they earned. This is straying far into error.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ اِنۡ يَّشَاۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ وَيَاۡتِ بِخَلۡقٍ جَدِيۡدٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O listener!) Have you not seen that Allah has created the heavens and the earth in accordance with (a strategy based on) the Truth. He can annihilate you if He so wills and bring new creation (in your place).

Verses.VerseAr: وَّمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ بِعَزِيۡزٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And this is not (in the least) difficult for Allah (to execute).

Verses.VerseAr: وَبَرَزُوۡا لِلّٰهِ جَمِيۡعًا فَقَالَ الضُّعَفٰۤؤُا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡۤا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَـكُمۡ تَبَعًا فَهَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ مُّغۡـنُوۡنَ عَنَّا مِنۡ عَذَابِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ قَالُوۡا لَوۡ هَدٰٮنَا اللّٰهُ لَهَدَيۡنٰكُمۡ‌ؕ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَاۤ اَجَزِعۡنَاۤ اَمۡ صَبَرۡنَا مَا لَــنَا مِنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (on the Day of Grand Assembly) all (the higher and the lower ranks) will appear before Allah. The weak ones (the followers) will ask the (powerful) arrogant ones: ‘We obeyed you (the whole life). So can you now manage for us some degree of rescue from Allah’s torment?’ Those (affluent ones) will reply (to their poor followers): ‘Had Allah guided us, we would also have shown you the path of guidance (i.e. we were ourselves misguided so we misguided you too). It is all the same (today) whether we sigh and wail or forbear. We have no way to escape.’

Words.MeaningEn: surely we would have guided you

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ لَـمَّا قُضِىَ الۡاَمۡرُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَعَدَكُمۡ وَعۡدَ الۡحَـقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمۡ فَاَخۡلَفۡتُكُمۡ‌ؕ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ دَعَوۡتُكُمۡ فَاسۡتَجَبۡتُمۡ لِىۡ‌ۚ فَلَا تَلُوۡمُوۡنِىۡ وَلُوۡمُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ‌ؕ مَاۤ اَنَا بِمُصۡرِخِكُمۡ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُصۡرِخِىَّ‌ ؕ اِنِّىۡ كَفَرۡتُ بِمَاۤ اَشۡرَكۡتُمُوۡنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ‌ؕ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the decision will have been given, Satan will say: ‘Indeed Allah gave you a true promise, and I (also) promised you something; so I have violated the promise. And I had no authority over you (in the world) except that I called you (towards falsehood). So you accepted my call (for your own interest). Now do not blame me but blame your (own) selves. I can do nothing (today) to help you out, nor can you extend any help to me. Before this you have been associating me as a partner (with Allah). Surely I deny that (today).’ Undoubtedly there is a painful punishment for the wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاُدۡخِلَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ‌ؕ تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ فِيۡهَا سَلٰمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who believe and stick to pious deeds will be admitted to the Gardens with streams flowing under them. They will live there forever by the Command of Allah. Their greeting word there (at the time of meeting) will be: ‘Peace.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلاً كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ اَصۡلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَّفَرۡعُهَا فِىۡ السَّمَآءِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you not seen how Allah sets forth the example: a good word is like a good tree? Its root is firm (in the earth) and its branches reach into the sky.

Verses.VerseAr: تُؤۡتِىۡۤ اُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِيۡنٍۢ بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهَا‌ؕ وَيَضۡرِبُ اللّٰهُ الۡاَمۡثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (That tree) yields fruit at all times by the Command of its Lord, and Allah illustrates examples for the people so that they may take advice.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيۡثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيۡثَةٍ  ۨاجۡتُثَّتۡ مِنۡ فَوۡقِ الۡاَرۡضِ مَا لَهَا مِنۡ قَرَارٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the example of an evil word is like that of an evil tree which is uprooted from the surface of the earth (and) which has no chance to get firm (in the soil and survive).

Verses.VerseAr: يُثَبِّتُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِالۡقَوۡلِ الثَّابِتِ فِىۡ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَفِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ‌ۚ وَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‌ۙ وَيَفۡعَلُ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَآءُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah keeps the believers firm-footed in the life of this world as well as in the Hereafter with (the blessing) of this Firm Word, but Allah holds the wrongdoers astray. And Allah puts into action whatever He wills.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلَى الَّذِيۡنَ بَدَّلُوۡا نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ كُفۡرًا وَّاَحَلُّوۡا قَوۡمَهُمۡ دَارَ الۡبَوَارِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you not seen those who have exchanged Allah’s Favour (of belief) for disbelief and have lowered their people into the house of destruction?

Verses.VerseAr: جَهَـنَّمَ‌ۚ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا‌ؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرَارُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (That) is Hell in which they will be thrown headlong, and that is an evil abode.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلُوۡا لِلّٰهِ اَنۡدَادًا لِّيُـضِلُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖ‌ؕ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعُوۡا فَاِنَّ مَصِيۡرَكُمۡ اِلَى النَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they set up partners with Allah so that they may turn (the people) away from His path. Say: ‘Benefit (a few days’) gain; surely you will end up in the Fire.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُل لِّـعِبَادِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يُقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ سِرًّا وَّعَلَانِيَةً مِّنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِىَ يَوۡمٌ لَّا بَيۡعٌ فِيۡهِ وَلَا خِلٰلٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say to My servants who have believed that they must establish Prayer and spend (in Our Way) both secretly and openly of the provision that We have granted them before the dawn of the Day when neither any transaction will take place nor any (worldly) friendship (will profit).

Verses.VerseAr: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَاَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَخۡرَجَ بِهٖ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزۡقًا لَّـكُمۡ‌ۚ وَسَخَّرَ لَـكُمُ الۡـفُلۡكَ لِتَجۡرِىَ فِىۡ الۡبَحۡرِ بِاَمۡرِهٖ‌ۚ وَسَخَّرَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَنۡهٰرَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth and poured down water from the sky and then by means of this water produced fruits for you as provision. And He has made vessels subservient to you so that they may sail in the sea by Allah’s Command and He has (also) put rivers under your control.

Verses.VerseAr: وَسَخَّرَ لَـكُمُ الشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ دَآٮِٕبَيۡنِ‌ۚ وَسَخَّرَ لَـكُمُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And for your benefit He has subjected the sun and the moon (to a regular system); they keep rotating (in their respective orbits). And He has also subdued the night and the day (to a system) for your (system of life).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰتٰٮكُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ مَا سَاَلۡـتُمُوۡهُ‌ؕ وَاِنۡ تَعُدُّوۡا نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحۡصُوۡهَاؕ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَـظَلُوۡمٌ كَفَّارٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He has given you everything that you asked Him for and if you seek to number the Favours of Allah, you will not be able to count them all. Indeed Man is highly unjust and extremely ungrateful.

Words.MeaningEn: you will (be able to) count them

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡ هٰذَا الۡبَلَدَ اٰمِنًا وَّاجۡنُبۡنِىۡ وَبَنِىَّ اَنۡ نَّـعۡبُدَ الۡاَصۡنَامَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (recall the time) when Ibrahim (Abraham) submitted: ‘O my Lord, make this city (Makka) a land of peace and keep me and my children from idol-worship.

Verses.VerseAr: رَبِّ اِنَّهُنَّ اَضۡلَلۡنَ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ‌ۚ فَمَنۡ تَبِعَنِىۡ فَاِنَّهٗ مِنِّىۡ‌ۚ وَمَنۡ عَصَانِىۡ فَاِنَّكَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my Lord! These (idols) have led many people astray. So whoever follows me will belong to me, and whoever disobeys me then indeed You are Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: رَّبَّنَاۤ اِنِّىۡۤ اَسۡكَنۡتُ مِنۡ ذُرِّيَّتِىۡ بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِىۡ زَرۡعٍ عِنۡدَ بَيۡتِكَ الۡمُحَرَّمِۙ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيۡمُوۡا الصَّلٰوةَ فَاجۡعَلۡ اَفۡـٮِٕدَةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهۡوِىۡۤ اِلَيۡهِمۡ وَارۡزُقۡهُمۡ مِّنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O our Lord! Verily, I have settled my offspring (Isma‘il [Ishmael]) in the barren valley (of Makka) in the close vicinity of Your Sacred House, O our Lord, so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of the people incline towards them with love and fondness, and provide for them (all kinds of) fruits as sustenance so that they may remain grateful.

Verses.VerseAr: رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّكَ تَعۡلَمُ مَا نُخۡفِىۡ وَمَا نُعۡلِنُ‌ؕ وَمَا يَخۡفٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O our Lord! Surely You know (all) what we hide and what we show, and there is nothing which is hidden from Allah either on earth or in the heaven.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ وَهَبَ لِىۡ عَلَى الۡـكِبَرِ اِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّىۡ لَسَمِيۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: All praise belongs to Allah alone Who has bestowed upon me (two sons) in old age, Isma‘il (Ishmael) and Ishaq (Isaac). Indeed my Lord is the All-Hearer of prayer.

Verses.VerseAr: رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡنِىۡ مُقِيۡمَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَمِنۡ ذُرِّيَّتِىۡ‌‌ۖ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my Lord! Make me and my children the ones who establish Prayer; O my Lord, and grant my prayer.

Verses.VerseAr: رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لِىۡ وَلـِوَالِدَىَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ يَوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ الۡحِسَابُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my Lord! Forgive me and (forgive) my parents and all the believers as well on the Day when reckoning (and accountability) will be held.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ اللّٰهَ غَافِلاً عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ‌ ؕ اِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٍ تَشۡخَصُ فِيۡهِ الۡاَبۡصَارُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And never think of Allah to be unaware of the works the wrongdoers are doing. He is only giving them (the wrongdoers) respite till the Day on which the eyes will be stare-fixed (in horror).

Verses.VerseAr: مُهۡطِعِيۡنَ مُقۡنِعِىۡ رُءُوۡسِهِمۡ لَا يَرۡتَدُّ اِلَيۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡ‌ۚ وَاَفۡـِٕدَتُهُمۡ هَوَآءٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Their heads lifted up, they will be running (towards the Field of Reckoning-Assembly), with eyes unable to twinkle and with hearts being drained of strength.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡذِرِ النَّاسَ يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِيۡهِمُ الۡعَذَابُ فَيَـقُوۡلُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا رَبَّنَاۤ اَخِّرۡنَاۤ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ قَرِيۡبٍۙ نُّجِبۡ دَعۡوَتَكَ وَنَـتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَ‌ؕ اَوَلَمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡۤا اَقۡسَمۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ زَوَالٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And warn the people of the Day when the torment will come upon them. Those who will have been doing injustice will say: ‘O our Lord, grant us respite for a while so that we may accept Your message and follow the Messengers.’ (It will be said to them:) ‘Are you not those who used to swear before that you would never fall?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَّسَكَنۡتُمۡ فِىۡ مَسٰكِنِ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَـكُمۡ كَيۡفَ فَعَلۡنَا بِهِمۡ وَضَرَبۡنَا لَـكُمُ الۡاَمۡثَالَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (in your own turn) you were dwelling in the palaces (vacated by) those who had wronged their souls (during their respective eras) whereas this had dawned on you how We had dealt with them and We also elucidated examples for your (easy comprehension).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَدۡ مَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرَهُمۡ وَعِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ مَكۡرُهُمۡؕ وَاِنۡ كَانَ مَكۡرُهُمۡ لِتَزُوۡلَ مِنۡهُ الۡجِبَالُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (having lost their balance intoxicated by wealth and power) they hatched many plots while Allah had the countermeasures to foil all their plots, although their deceitful strategies were sufficient even to uproot the mountains.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا تَحۡسَبَنَّ اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِفَ وَعۡدِهٖ رُسُلَهٗؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيۡزٌ ذُوۡ انتِقَامٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So never think that Allah will ever break His promise with His Messengers. Indeed Allah is Almighty, the Lord of Retribution.

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ تُبَدَّلُ الۡاَرۡضُ غَيۡرَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ‌ وَبَرَزُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الۡوَاحِدِ الۡقَهَّارِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when (this) earth will be changed into a different earth and all the heavens will also be changed and the entire mankind will appear before Allah, the One, and the Dominant over all.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَرَى الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ مُّقَرَّنِيۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَصۡفَادِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that Day you will see the sinners fettered in chains;

Verses.VerseAr: سَرَابِيۡلُهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَطِرَانٍ وَّتَغۡشٰى وُجُوۡهَهُمُ النَّارُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Their garments will be of pitch (or some inflammable oil) and the Fire will be enveloping their faces,

Verses.VerseAr: لِيَجۡزِىَ اللّٰهُ كُلَّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيۡعُ الۡحِسَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that Allah may requite every soul for (the deeds) it has earned. Indeed Allah is Swift in Reckoning.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا بَلٰغٌ لِّـلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنۡذَرُوۡا بِهٖ وَلِيَـعۡلَمُوۡۤا اَنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰـهٌ وَّاحِدٌ وَّلِيَذَّكَّرَ اُولُوۡا الۡاَلۡبَابِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (Qur’an) is perfect communication of the Message to mankind so that by means of this they may be warned and that they may conscientiously bear it in mind that He (Allah) is One God, and that those who possess wisdom may take advice.
